seo.title: Best Cocktail Bars in Antwerp (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Antwerp's top cocktail bars, from hidden speakeasies to vibrant lounges. Our expert guide helps you find the perfect spot for classic and craft cocktails in 2026.

hero.subtitle: Antwerp's cocktail scene is a sophisticated blend of timeless classics, innovative craft creations, and cozy, welcoming atmospheres, making it a prime destination for discerning drinkers.

picks.name: SIPS
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Widely regarded as one of Antwerp's finest, SIPS offers a truly elevated cocktail experience. Bartenders here are artisans, crafting inventive and beautifully presented drinks using premium spirits and unique ingredients. The ambiance is sophisticated yet inviting, perfect for a special evening.
picks.whatToOrder: Ask the bartender for a personalized creation based on your preferences, or try their seasonal signature cocktail.
picks.insiderTip: Reservations are highly recommended, especially on weekends, as this intimate bar fills up quickly. It's an ideal spot for a pre-dinner drink or a sophisticated nightcap.
picks.redditQuote: "Honestly, SIPS is just on another level. I've never had a bad drink there, and their creativity is insane. Worth every euro."

picks.name: Dogma Cocktails
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Step into the intimate world of Dogma, a classic speakeasy that transports you back to the Prohibition era. Known for its impeccable service and perfectly executed classic cocktails, Dogma also offers a range of inventive house specials. The dark, plush interior sets a sophisticated and mysterious tone.
picks.whatToOrder: Their Old Fashioned is legendary, or venture out with a 'Bartender's Choice' for a delightful surprise.
picks.insiderTip: Look for the subtle entrance and be prepared to be immersed in a true cocktail connoisseur's paradise. It's a great spot for a date night or serious cocktail appreciation.
picks.redditQuote: "Dogma is my go-to for a proper cocktail. The atmosphere is amazing, and their Negroni is consistently perfect. Always a great experience."

picks.name: Belroy's
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Belroy's exudes an old-world charm with its elegant decor and extensive selection of gins and whiskies, alongside a meticulously crafted cocktail menu. It’s a place where knowledgeable bartenders guide you through their offerings, ensuring a drink tailored to your taste. The ambiance is refined and relaxed.
picks.whatToOrder: Explore their impressive gin menu or try a perfectly balanced Boulevardier.
picks.insiderTip: This bar can get busy, so arrive earlier in the evening to secure a good spot and enjoy a more personal interaction with the bartenders. They love talking about their spirits.
picks.redditQuote: "Belroy's has such a cool, understated vibe. Their gin selection is massive, and the staff really know their stuff. Definitely a hidden gem."

picks.name: Bardeau
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Bardeau offers a chic and contemporary setting, combining a fantastic wine list with an excellent array of modern cocktails. It’s a vibrant spot, popular with a trendy crowd, making it ideal for a lively evening out. The drinks are innovative, fresh, and beautifully presented.
picks.whatToOrder: Their seasonal fruit-infused cocktails or a classic Aperol Spritz with a twist.
picks.insiderTip: The outdoor terrace is a fantastic spot during warmer months for people-watching. It's a great place to start your evening before dinner.
picks.redditQuote: "Bardeau always hits the spot for a fun night. The cocktails are super fresh, and the whole vibe is just great, especially outside."

picks.name: The Dirty Rabbit
picks.whyItMadeTheList: For a more energetic and casual cocktail experience, The Dirty Rabbit is a fantastic choice. Located in the trendy Eilandje district, it's known for its upbeat atmosphere, friendly staff, and a menu of accessible, well-made cocktails. It's perfect for groups looking for fun and good music.
picks.whatToOrder: Try one of their themed shots or a refreshing Moscow Mule.
picks.insiderTip: This place can turn into a lively party spot later in the evening, so if you're looking for a quieter drink, go earlier. It's great for meeting new people.
picks.redditQuote: "Dirty Rabbit is my favorite for a casual night out. The cocktails are solid, the music's good, and it's always a fun crowd without breaking the bank."

picks.name: Cocktails at Nine
picks.whyItMadeTheList: An Antwerp institution, Cocktails at Nine delivers a consistently high-quality experience in a refined setting. With a focus on perfectly balanced classic cocktails, this bar appeals to those who appreciate tradition and timeless elegance. The service is impeccable, and the atmosphere is always sophisticated.
picks.whatToOrder: You can't go wrong with their Martini, prepared exactly to your liking.
picks.insiderTip: This bar is known for its classic approach; don't expect overly experimental drinks. It's a place to savor well-made, traditional cocktails.
picks.redditQuote: "Cocktails at Nine is just a classic. If you want a perfect Martini or a properly made Negroni, this is the place. No fuss, just quality."

picks.name: Jones & Co.
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Jones & Co. offers a cozy and welcoming atmosphere, feeling like a stylish neighborhood bar where everyone is a regular. They excel at crafting classic cocktails with precision and care, making it a reliable spot for a quality drink without pretension. It's a great place for intimate conversations.
picks.whatToOrder: Their Old Fashioned or a refreshing Gin & Tonic from their curated selection.
picks.insiderTip: The bar has a more relaxed vibe earlier in the week. It's a perfect spot for an after-work drink or a quiet evening with friends.
picks.redditQuote: "Love Jones & Co.! It's got that perfect cozy bar feel, and their cocktails are always on point. The bartenders are super friendly too."

picks.name: The Pharmacy
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The Pharmacy, as its name suggests, is a concept bar where cocktails are 'prescribed' and crafted with scientific precision and artistic flair. Located in the beautiful Zurenborg district, it offers a truly unique drinking experience with inventive flavour combinations and stunning presentations. It's a must-visit for the adventurous.
picks.whatToOrder: Ask for their most experimental seasonal concoction; you won't be disappointed.
picks.insiderTip: The bar is located in the charming Zurenborg neighborhood, known for its Art Nouveau architecture. Combine your visit with a stroll through the area.
picks.redditQuote: "The Pharmacy blew my mind! Every drink is a work of art, and the concepts behind them are so cool. Definitely worth the trip to Zurenborg."

picks.name: Bar Zar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Bar Zar is a popular and lively spot known for its energetic atmosphere and spacious terrace, especially bustling in warmer weather. They offer a diverse menu of crowd-pleasing cocktails, perfect for socializing and enjoying the vibrant city life. It's a fantastic place to start or end your evening.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic Mojito or one of their refreshing gin and tonics.
picks.insiderTip: Grab a spot on the terrace for excellent people-watching if the weather permits. It's a great place for groups.
picks.redditQuote: "Bar Zar is always buzzing, especially when the sun's out. Their cocktails are good, and the vibe is just infectious. Love it there!"

picks.name: Mundo
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Mundo brings a taste of Latin America to Antwerp with its vibrant decor and menu of exotic, fruit-forward cocktails. It's a fun, colorful spot perfect for those looking for something a bit different, perhaps a lively start to a night out or a casual gathering with friends. The ambiance is festive and inviting.
picks.whatToOrder: Their Caipirinha or a fresh Pisco Sour.
picks.insiderTip: Check their schedule for any live music or themed nights, which often add to the already lively atmosphere.
picks.redditQuote: "Mundo is my happy place for a cocktail. The flavors are so vibrant, and it actually feels like you're on vacation. Their Caipirinhas are amazing."

picks.name: Kafie Kabinet
picks.whyItMadeTheList: By day, Kafie Kabinet is a popular coffee spot, but by night, it transforms into a cozy bar offering a selection of well-crafted cocktails. It maintains a relaxed, unpretentious vibe, making it a great choice for a casual drink or if you appreciate coffee-infused concoctions. It's a comfortable, low-key gem.
picks.whatToOrder: An Espresso Martini or a classic Negroni.
picks.insiderTip: If you love coffee, try one of their coffee-based cocktails. It's a unique offering that blends their daytime specialty with nighttime libations.
picks.redditQuote: "Kafie Kabinet is perfect for a chill evening. Their coffee cocktails are surprisingly good, and it's just a really laid-back place to hang out."

picks.name: Mama's Kelly
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Mama's Kelly is an ultra-stylish, pink-themed cocktail bar that is as much about the aesthetics as it is about the drinks. Located in the fashionable Zuid district, it's a popular spot for photos and a fun, glamorous night out. The cocktails are vibrant and playful, matching the decor.
picks.whatToOrder: Any of their signature pink-hued cocktails; they are all Instagram-worthy.
picks.insiderTip: This bar is particularly popular with groups and for celebrations. Expect a lively atmosphere and plenty of photo opportunities.
picks.redditQuote: "If you're into cute, pink bars and delicious, pretty cocktails, Mama's Kelly is a must. So much fun with my girlfriends!"

faq.question: What is the typical price range for a cocktail in Antwerp?
faq.answer: The price for a cocktail in Antwerp generally ranges from €12 to €20 ($13 to $22 USD). Classic cocktails at more casual bars might be on the lower end, while signature or craft cocktails at high-end establishments can reach the higher end of this spectrum, or even exceed it for premium spirits.

faq.question: Are reservations required for cocktail bars in Antwerp?
faq.answer: For some of the more popular or intimate cocktail bars, especially SIPS and Dogma, reservations are highly recommended, particularly on weekend evenings, to guarantee a spot. For most other bars, walking in is usually fine, though you might encounter a wait during peak hours.

faq.question: What kind of cocktail bars can I expect to find in Antwerp?
faq.answer: Antwerp offers a diverse range of cocktail experiences, from sophisticated speakeasies with a focus on classic drinks to trendy modern bars with innovative craft cocktails. You'll also find lively, casual spots perfect for groups, and even concept bars that push the boundaries of mixology. There's something for every taste and occasion.

faq.question: Which neighborhood is best for cocktail bar hopping in Antwerp?
faq.answer: The Historisch Centrum (Historic Centre) is an excellent area for cocktail bar hopping, boasting a high concentration of quality bars within walking distance, including SIPS, Bardeau, and Jones & Co. The Theaterbuurt and Eilandje districts also offer several notable options, providing a good mix of styles and atmospheres.

faq.question: Do Antwerp's cocktail bars offer non-alcoholic options?
faq.answer: Yes, most reputable cocktail bars in Antwerp are increasingly offering a selection of creative and well-crafted non-alcoholic cocktails, often referred to as 'mocktails' or 'nolo' (no-low) drinks. Don't hesitate to ask your bartender for recommendations or bespoke alcohol-free creations.

faq.question: Is tipping customary at cocktail bars in Antwerp?
faq.answer: Tipping is not as deeply ingrained in Belgian culture as it is in some other countries like the US, but it is always appreciated for good service. For exceptional service at a cocktail bar, rounding up the bill or leaving an extra few euros (e.g., 5-10% of the bill) is a thoughtful gesture, but not strictly mandatory.

methodology: Our selection of Antwerp's best cocktail bars is based on extensive research, expert reviews, local recommendations, and consistent customer feedback. We prioritized venues with exceptional drink quality, unique atmospheres, knowledgeable staff, and a reputation for memorable experiences, ensuring a diverse range of options for every preference.
